description: This file defines a ViewModel class `TasksViewModel` for managing task data within an Android application. It interacts with a repository to observe, add, update, delete, and restore tasks, providing data and actions for the UI layer.

classes.name: TasksViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing task data and actions, providing observable task list and functions to modify tasks.

methods.name: seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Initializes the repository with default tasks if it is empty.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task with specified title, optional description, and due date.

methods.name: setCompleted
methods.description: Marks a task as completed or not.

methods.name: clearCompletedTasks
methods.description: Deletes all tasks marked as completed.

methods.name: restoreTask
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted task, used for undo actions.

methods.name: getTaskById
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its ID asynchronously.
